lines.text: Ah. The new Handler. Slow down. ...No, truly. Most people move like the next second is free.
Every second is borrowed. Move someone. Brace something. Choose. Act. Don't admire the miracle — use it.
Aruun held a bridge again. Tell him I'm proud. Do not tell him I said proud.
Some things don't break. They just take longer. That bridge is taking longer.
Have you seen the new forklift in Bay Four? Don't answer. I'm going to go look at it again.
